findings.description: worker_failure assigns learner.api.absolute_deadline only after notify_failure returns. Missing/invalid ACK raises from the first except hook, but Python still executes the unconditional finally block. Because result remains its initial failed value, finally starts an emergency checkpoint and checkpoint-index persistence before any acknowledged shared deadline.
findings.expected: A failed notification/ACK must prevent all emergency checkpoint/index/result persistence; fail and exit through the already bounded executor path. A valid ACK permits failure persistence only under its acknowledged shared deadline.
findings.impact_boundary: This does not demonstrate outer acceptance of a failed run. The outer executor should reject the raw worker failure or IPC loss and enforce cleanup. The demonstrated defect is prohibited local persistence before ACK and stale deadline use, plus missing real-worker failure-branch coverage.
findings.proof_scope: Stdlib execution of exact worker_failure/outcome helper AST and original worker except/finally AST; only the try body is replaced with a controlled failure. Fake model/persistence callbacks record calls in memory. No candidate module, ML package, real checkpoint or actual failure file was loaded/written.
findings.required_fix: Add an explicit acknowledged-persistence gate; set/check the shared failure bound before any failed-worker write. On ACK failure do no checkpoint/index persistence. Add both missing/invalid ACK regressions and a valid-ACK positive control against the actual worker exception/finally path.
findings.title: Failed failure-notification ACK still enters emergency persistence with stale normal deadline
